description: T2C: Per-asset slippage calibration from historical Binance 1h intrabar ranges (2020-2026). base_slippage_bps = P25 intrabar range (low-vol regime proxy). vol_factor scales with realized bar volatility.
methodology: intrabar_range_bps = (high-low)/mid * 10000. Per-asset base_slippage_bps set to P25 (quiet-market slippage). slippage_volatility_factor computed as slope of regression intrabar_bps ~ realized_vol.
